use tower_layer::{Identity, Layer, LayerFn, Stack, layer_fn};
use uuid::Uuid;

fn main() {
    let text = "67e55044-10b1-426f-9247-bb680e5fe0c8";
    let parsed = Uuid::parse_str(text).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(parsed.to_string(), text);
    assert_eq!(Uuid::parse_str("{67e55044-10b1-426f-9247-bb680e5fe0c8}").unwrap(), parsed);
    assert_eq!(Uuid::parse_str("67e5504410b1426f9247bb680e5fe0c8").unwrap(), parsed);
    assert_eq!(Uuid::parse_str("urn:uuid:67e55044-10b1-426f-9247-bb680e5fe0c8").unwrap(), parsed);
    assert!(Uuid::parse_str("bad").is_err());
    assert_eq!(Uuid::from_bytes(*parsed.as_bytes()), parsed);
    assert_eq!(Uuid::nil().to_string(), "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000");
    println!("{parsed}");

    let add: LayerFn<_> = layer_fn(|value: i32| value + 7);
    assert_eq!(Identity::new().layer(3), 3);
    assert_eq!((&add).layer(5), 12);
    assert_eq!((layer_fn(|n: i32| n * 2), layer_fn(|n: i32| n + 3)).layer(5), 16);
    assert_eq!((layer_fn(|n: i32| n * 2), layer_fn(|n: i32| n + 3), Identity::new()).layer(5), 16);
    assert_eq!(Stack::new(layer_fn(|n: i32| n + 3), layer_fn(|n: i32| n * 2)).layer(5), 16);
    println!("uuid and tower-layer complete");
}
